commit_message:
records 80 bifurcated (#146)

* dol.records: BifurcatedProvider, records beside their blobs

Content fields go to a dol.content store (put_content) and the record
keeps their ContentRef wire dicts; get_one(resolve_content=True) and
get_content fetch the bytes. The metadata record is the commit point:
content is written before the record refers to it (a new record is
created first for its id, and deleted again if a content write fails),
and removed after the record is gone.

Part of #80

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* dol.records: wrap_provider, the records analog of wrap_kvs

WrappedProvider sees a provider through a record codec: encode on the
way in (create, update, update_many, upsert), decode on the way out
(get_list, get_one and every write's result); queries pass through and
name stored fields, as in zodal's wrapProvider.

Closes #80

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
